styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, cobalt-blue #1B4FD8 and deep navy #16307A panels for benefit and info screens, dim plum-violet #2A2140 for night ambience, white subway tile #F2F4F6 for in-home walls
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool 6000K key with soft fill, a tight cool glow #2E63D8 pooling around the product shoulder, soft contact shadows only, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy white subway tile #F2F4F6 and matte light-stone counter #E9E4DD
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; all in-image copy stripped, headlines and labels carried by blank bars and empty grid rows only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular icon nodes with hairline leader lines, single violet accent #6B3FC4, abstract glyphs only
styleLock.presentationRules: the upright unit keeps one vertical stance, the same slight 3/4 hero angle and a constant scale across the whole set; the shoulder glow always reads as one soft halo
noDrift: no realistic insects or pest carcasses
no rendered brand marks, badges or numerals
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool-tech home pest-control visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cobalt blue #1B4FD8, deep navy #16307A, violet accent #6B3FC4 and charcoal text #2D2D2D; cool 6000K key light with soft fill and a tight cool glow #2E63D8 pooling around the product shoulder, soft contact shadows only, no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with every headline and label reduced to blank bars and empty grid rows; thin-line circular icon nodes in one violet accent; the upright product shown at a stable slight 3/4 angle and constant scale; clean high-end home-care product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no realistic insects.

Bright even high-key 6000K studio lighting, front key with soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the base. Seamless white #FFFFFF background. provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 盒装正面陈列，立式主机与卡匣并排、两枚圆形件数徽标；02 左色块三条主张栏＋右白瓷砖墙插机与果盘；03 暗调房间，墙插机肩口泛冷光、四周有飞虫聚拢与环形时钟图形；04 手持卡匣、圆形放大镜圈出卡扣图标、顶部一行尺寸适配字样；05 手持卡匣特写、左色块补货主张；06 白瓷砖墙插机＋右侧四行圆形图标与引线列表、底部一行小字注解；07 手持满捕卡匣、左侧巨型比例数字主张；08 转角墙插机近景，左侧墙上为虚线飞行轨迹箭头，绿植虚影；09 三栏色块家族对照图（三挡位、各自标题与主张）。品类判定依据：以图判品，主体为插在墙插上的立式诱捕小件，无电机、无加热、非清洁或环境类家电，功能属室内驱虫，故取 L1 家居日用／L2 驱虫，而非家用电器；源平台类目仅作检索线索，未据此定档。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与盒面美术、包装版面、全部英文原句与巨型数字主张、件数徽标内的数字、时钟与环形图形上的读数、适配型号说明、榜单与销量类社会证明、小字注解脚注、原平台店铺字样与任何角标；手持镜头只保留「一只手托举」的动作角色，不含身份与面容；含虫画面全部改写为抽象虚线飞行轨迹与空白图标节点，并在每镜负面清单里显式禁止写实木虫与尸身；一切功率、时长、比例与效率百分比类数字均未入稿，改以空白标签栏、空表格行与留空印章框承载。
